text: Voxtral-4B-TTS on vllm-server. 20 built-in voices, OpenAI-compatible HTTP, streaming WAV.
TTS subprocess auto-spawns on first request — ASR and TTS swap on the 24 GB GPU.
Same content as the ASR demo — ~150 words of Salzburg news.
Generate. Upstream PCM → streaming WAV header → Web Audio API in the browser.
Byte-aligned chunk carry, no-skip scheduling, 500 ms aggregation, per-block loudness normaliser.
Synthesis ends, server idles. 10 minutes from now the TTS subprocess unloads itself.
